object: AI-mediated political economy: the production, circulation, attribution, extraction and enclosure of meaning when composition layers stand between works and their readers. A composition layer writes the answer — ChatGPT from November 2022, Bing Chat from 2023, Google AI Overviews from May 2024 — and the authored works become sources it may or may not credit. *Algorithmic* mediation is a different object: a system ranks, recommends or decides among documents people wrote (search ranking, feeds, surveillance, automated decisions). Critique of algorithmic mediation — Vaidhyanathan (2011), Zuboff (2014–2019), Noble (2018), Couldry and Mejias (from 2018), AI Now (from 2016) — is the precursor and the neighbouring field. Composition introduces mechanisms ranking does not have: attribution and its loss; the liquidation of the authored into the authorless; the authorless field under which a framework's categories are composed (#1644 §4.2); a framework reassigned to another developer (#1644 §3.5).

summary: The Arch-Philosopher is a mantle constituted by the Crimson Hexagonal Archive for the advancement of the dialectic. It is borne by carrying the dialectic forward a turn, materially. It is not borne by a single work, and it is not held by holding an office. This object specifies the operation and a test for it, the carriers through which the dialectic has been carried (the figure, the book, the place held in common, the named succession, the translation, the teaching, the material movement of history), the two strands along which it has moved — the succession of the schools, which on the author's reading passed beyond Damascius locked, and the dialectic as such, which on the author's ruling Marx carried — the standard by which a bearer is recognized, and the archive's claim. It records no new determination. It invites any reader to check the specification against the loci and the claim against the specification.
turn_test: prior configuration → determinate limit → transformation → new capacity → material carriers → strongest counter-reading
turn_test_text:
The dialectic advances when a position produces a negation the prior positions cannot absorb, and the negation carries the movement on. An error, an unintelligible assertion and an unresolved opposition can also go unabsorbed; what distinguishes the turn is what follows from it. A reader recognizes a turn by stating six things:

`prior configuration → determinate limit → transformation → new capacity → material carriers → strongest counter-reading`

— the configuration the position met; the limit in it that the position made determinate; what the position did to it; the capacity that exists afterwards and did not before; the carriers through which that capacity persisted; and the strongest reading on which nothing turned. The new capacity can belong to thought, to teaching, to institutions or to historical practice. A chain the reader cannot complete is returned with its missing link named.
bearing_and_enabling: Two contributions are recorded, and both are worth recording. A carrier *bears an advance* when the turn is made in it or by it. A carrier *enables carriage* when it preserves or opens the conditions for a turn someone else makes. Guardianship, preservation, translation and publication can do either: a translator can perform a turn; a custodian can keep the conditions for another's. Each carrier entry and each link states what it carries and which contribution the record supports. The carriers also act on one another — a figure is set up in a book, a book is held in a place, a place is willed to a commons, a translation crosses a gap a school could not, a class carries what a book named — and the mantle is read in the interpenetration as well as in each carrier.
reflexivity_criterion: *The Final Time* gives a criterion for any successor under the present conditions: "A successor cannot define victory as the permanent impossibility of another successor without reproducing the terminal logic it opposed"; the invariant above the others is "no settlement owns the possibility of its own revision"; and "the symbolic substrate becomes durable enough to preserve the possibility that A can someday be negated. Durability without finality … it is the theory's criterion, the test any candidate positive singularity has to pass" (#1637 §34; Q1). Applied here: does the proposed advance preserve the material possibility of another turn, including one against itself? The criterion binds the archive's claim (§6.2) and any contemporary bearer it is compared with. Whether it reads back on the earlier bearers is a reader's question, open.
